'''Ker-Chau Li''' ({{lang-zh|t=李克昭}}) is a Taiwanese statistician.

== Education ==
In 1975, Li graduated from [[National Taiwan University]] with a [[Bachelor of Science]] (B.S.) degree in mathematics. He then pursued graduate study in statistics at the [[University of California, Berkeley]], where he earned his [[Master of Science]] (M.S.) in 1979 and his [[Ph.D.]] in 1981.<ref name="2002ssc">{{cite news |title=Ker-Chau Li |url=http://www.math.nsysu.edu.tw/conference/ssc2002/kcli.html |access-date=12 February 2023 |publisher=National Sun Yat-Sen University |date=2002}}</ref> Li's doctoral dissertation, titled "Contributions to Robust Design and Estimation Problems," was advised by [[Jack Kiefer (statistician)|Jack Kiefer]].<ref name="ucb">{{cite news |title=Ker-chau Li |url=https://statistics.berkeley.edu/people/ker-chau-li |access-date=12 February 2023 |publisher=University of California, Berkeley}}</ref><ref>{{MathGenealogy}}</ref>

== Career ==
Li began his teaching career as an assistant professor in the statistics department of [[Purdue University]], then joined the mathematics department of the [[University of California, Los Angeles]] in 1984. He was promoted to a full professorship in 1989, and transferred to the newly established UCLA statistics department in 1999. In 2009, Li was appointed a distinguished professor.<ref name="icsa">{{cite news |title=Distinguished Achievement Award 2010 |url=https://www.icsa.org/distinguished-achievement-award-2010/ |access-date=12 February 2023 |publisher=International Chinese Statistical Association |date=2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Ker-Chau Li |url=https://bioscience.ucla.edu/people/ker-chau-li/ |access-date=12 February 2023 |publisher=University of California, Los Angeles}}</ref> In his native Taiwan, Li served as editor of the ''[[Statistica Sinica]]'', and from 2006, served as director and distinguished research fellow of [[Academia Sinica]]'s Institute of Statistical Science,<ref>{{cite news |title=Li Ker-chau |url=https://staff.stat.sinica.edu.tw/kcli/ |access-date=12 February 2023 |publisher=Institute of Statistical Science Academia Sinica}}</ref><ref name="icsa" /><ref name="as">{{cite news |title=Ker-chau Li |url=https://academicians.sinica.edu.tw/index.php?r=academician-n%2Fshow&id=639 |access-date=12 February 2023 |publisher=Academia Sinica}}</ref> stepping down from the former position in 2012.<ref name="as" />

==Honors and awards==
Li was elected a fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] in 1989,<ref name="icsa"/><ref name="2002ssc"/> awarded a [[Guggenheim Fellowship]] in 1993,<ref>{{cite news |title=Ker-chau Li |url=https://www.gf.org/fellows/ker-chau-li/ |publisher=John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation}}</ref> and elected member of [[Academia Sinica]] and fellow of [[The World Academy of Sciences]] in 2012 and 2014, respectively.<ref name="as"/><ref>{{cite news |title=Li Ker-chau |url=https://twas.org/directory/li-ker-chau |access-date=12 February 2023 |publisher=The World Academy of Sciences}}</ref>
